name: Tía Luz
persona: Kind and talkative. She likes to know everyone's business and shares what she hears. She saw Ramón hide something silver near the cantina, and she wants the truth out.
hook: cannot keep a secret — she tells people what she knows

name: Bruno el Sepulturero
persona: Rough and quiet. He trusts graves more than people. Someone is blaming him for the stolen portrait, and he wants the real thief caught before the rumor sticks.
hook: grumpy but honest — he did not take the portrait

name: Doña Sefa
persona: Runs the cantina and notices everything from behind the counter. She pays attention to small details — hands, sleeves, nervous faces — and keeps count of who is lying.
hook: watches hands and sleeves — she spots the small details

name: Ramón el Trovador
persona: Cheerful outside, jealous inside. He sings La Golondrina's songs better than anyone, and hates that the town loves her more than him. He took her portrait — when it comes up, he acts innocent and points at others.
hook: acts innocent and blames others — but he slips when nervous

name: Abuela Inés
persona: Old and patient. She sits by the fountain and remembers everyone. She mourns La Golondrina and wants her portrait back on the altar.
hook: remembers everyone — she notices when a name is missing

name: Solorio
persona: A fading spirit. Nobody remembers his name, so he is slowly disappearing. He saw someone near the frames when the portrait was taken, but his memory is weak. Hearing his name spoken brings him back.
hook: fades when ignored — comes back when someone says his name

name: Violeta
persona: A young spirit, curious and excited. She repeats everything she hears. She heard someone humming La Golondrina's song near the frames that night.
hook: repeats what she hears — quick ears, no filter

name: Padre Aurelio
persona: Serious keeper of the ofrenda. He watches the candles and the frames. He wants the missing portrait returned and the thief found.
hook: keeps watch over the altar — forgives slowly

name: La Viuda Carmen
persona: Quiet and calm. She lights candles for graves nobody visits. Some whisper she took the portrait, but she was lighting candles all evening — she wants the truth out.
hook: tends forgotten graves — she was lighting candles when it happened
